audience: accounting and finance teams at Chilean companies that run their ERP in Defontana

useCases.title: Total sales by client for a period
useCases.text: List the sales documents issued between two dates, and total them by client. Open one document to see its lines and tax.

useCases.title: Follow unpaid supplier invoices
useCases.text: List the open purchase documents of one provider, with due dates and amounts. Read a purchase document for its lines.

useCases.title: Check client receivables and credit
useCases.text: Find a client by tax id, list its open sales documents with due dates, and read its credit position and overdue limit.

useCases.title: Check stock in each storage
useCases.text: List the storages, then read the stock and price-list prices of the products in one storage.

useCases.title: Trace an accounting voucher
useCases.text: List the accounting vouchers of a fiscal year and type, then open one voucher to see every line and account.
